member.name: GetValue(System.Data.IDataReader)
member.summary: Retrieves the value from the specified column, returning it converted to the specified type.
member.param: The IDataReader from which to read the value of the specified column.
member.returns: The value, converted to the type specified by the property.
member.remarks: The logic for reading the value from the database and returning the value is a straight-forward chain despite the fact that several different modes are supported. The user can specify to retrieve values as SqlDbTypes or OdbcTypes and so on. Not more than one of SqlDbType, DbType, TypeCode, OleDbType, OdbcType values should be specified; and specifying one is completely optional. This is because these values may invoke provider-specific methods on the underlying IDataReader. After reading the value from the database, the value is converted via the System.Convert class to the specified type.
